rationale: P characterises the braking-relevant situation, whether required braking occurs, and whether timely stopping is possible. These are established by the target, SG-1, the braking requirements, and H-1's collision-related hazardous event. Braking initiation is itself behaviour under evaluation, not merely an enabling control mechanism. The temporal aspect concerns stopping before collision, rather than internal sensing or processing deadlines. P does not incorporate implementation mechanisms.
determining_elements: The braking-relevant operational state in obstacle/collision-avoidance situations establishes the context in which braking is required.
Whether a required braking maneuver is initiated directly addresses the target and SG-1, supported by FR-7 and FR-7.1.
Whether the vehicle can stop in time to avoid collision directly reflects H-1's hazardous event and supports inclusion of this temporal property.
The declared straight-ahead road scope is grounded in H-1; inclusion of road users and static obstacles is supported by its hazardous event and FR-7.
